in_sanskrit.name: Sharvikaan
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Goddess Sharvi's Grace
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Sharvikaan एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Goddess Sharvi, a form of Goddess Saraswati, bestows her grace upon the child named Sharvikaan

in_tamil.name: Sharvikaan
in_tamil.meaning: இந்து பெயர் என்று பொருள் Goddess Sharvi's Grace
in_tamil.long_meaning: Sharvikaan ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। Goddess Sharvi, a form of Goddess Saraswati, bestows her grace upon the child named Sharvikaan

in_telugu.name: Sharvikaan
in_telugu.meaning: హిందూ పేరు అంటే Goddess Sharvi's Grace
in_telugu.long_meaning: Sharvikaan ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। Goddess Sharvi, a form of Goddess Saraswati, bestows her grace upon the child named Sharvikaan
